ideas.title: Cook a cuisine neither of you has tried
ideas.desc: Pick a country, choose one recipe each, shop together and cook side by side. Score the result out of ten and keep the winner.

ideas.title: Blind taste test
ideas.desc: Buy five versions of one thing, such as chocolate, crisps or cola. Blindfold each other, taste, rank, then reveal the labels.

ideas.title: Living-room picnic
ideas.desc: Blanket on the floor, finger food, a candle and both phones in another room. Surprisingly different from eating at the table.

ideas.title: Paint each other's portrait
ideas.desc: Set a twenty-minute timer and paint or draw each other. Swap at the end. The worse the portraits, the better the night.

ideas.title: Blanket fort film night
ideas.desc: Build a proper fort from chairs and sheets, then watch a film from the year you met. Snacks are compulsory.

ideas.title: Two-person book club
ideas.desc: Read the same short story or article during the week, then talk it through over tea. Take turns choosing.

ideas.title: Homemade pizza face-off
ideas.desc: Same dough, separate toppings, one oven. Each of you builds a pizza in secret and the other has to judge it honestly.

ideas.title: Memory lane slideshow
ideas.desc: Each of you picks ten photos from your time together and explains why. Cast them to the big screen if you can.

ideas.title: Board game tournament
ideas.desc: Best of three across three different games. Loser makes breakfast. Keep a running scoreboard on the fridge.

ideas.title: Learn a dance from a video
ideas.desc: Find a beginner swing, salsa or waltz tutorial, push the sofa back and get through one full song without stopping.

ideas.title: Plan a dream trip
ideas.desc: Choose a destination with no budget limit and plan it properly: route, stays, one meal each. Save it for someday.

ideas.title: Cocktail or mocktail lab
ideas.desc: Use whatever is in the cupboard. Each of you invents a drink for the other, names it and writes the menu description.

ideas.title: Puzzle and podcast night
ideas.desc: A jigsaw on the table, a podcast you both like and nowhere to be. Talking happens sideways, which is often easiest.

ideas.title: Letters to open in a year
ideas.desc: Write each other a letter about right now: what you love, what you hope for. Seal them and set a reminder for next year.

ideas.title: Spa night at home
ideas.desc: Face masks, a foot soak, a playlist and warm towels from the dryer. Take turns giving a ten-minute shoulder rub.

ideas.title: Co-op video game night
ideas.desc: Pick a game where you are on the same team. Working toward one goal beats competing when the aim is to feel close.

ideas.title: Bake something ambitious
ideas.desc: Choose a bake that is slightly beyond you both, like croissants or a layer cake. Success and failure are equally memorable.

ideas.title: Fondue night
ideas.desc: Cheese first, chocolate after. Eating slowly from one pot forces a long, unhurried dinner conversation.

ideas.title: Balcony or backyard stargazing
ideas.desc: Lights off, blanket out, a free sky-map app if you want one. Give your eyes fifteen minutes to adjust before you judge the view.

ideas.title: Karaoke for two
ideas.desc: Search any song plus the word karaoke. Each of you picks three for yourself and one the other person has to sing.

ideas.title: Recreate your first date at home
ideas.desc: Same food, same music, same outfits if they still fit. Compare what each of you remembers; the versions never quite match.

ideas.title: Build the playlist of us
ideas.desc: Add songs in order: the one from when you met, the road-trip one, the one from the hard month. Tell the story of each.

ideas.title: Breakfast for dinner
ideas.desc: Pancakes, eggs, the good coffee and pyjamas at seven in the evening. Low effort, high comfort.

ideas.title: No-screens candlelit evening
ideas.desc: Switch off everything with a screen for one evening. Candles, cards, talking. Notice how long the night suddenly feels.

ideas.title: Plant a windowsill herb garden
ideas.desc: A few pots, some soil and three herbs you actually cook with. Name them. Share watering duty.

ideas.title: Trivia night about each other
ideas.desc: Each of you writes ten quiz questions about your own life. Swap and answer. Works just as well over a video call.

ideas.title: Learn ten phrases in a new language
ideas.desc: Pick a language tied to a trip you would like to take. Learn ten useful phrases and use them for the rest of the night.

ideas.title: Stretch or yoga session together
ideas.desc: Follow a gentle beginner video side by side. A calm way to end a tense week without having to talk about it yet.

ideas.title: Themed movie marathon
ideas.desc: Pick a theme, such as one director or one decade, and cook snacks to match. Intermission walks keep it from becoming a nap.

ideas.title: Make a time capsule
ideas.desc: A shoebox, today's receipts, a photo, a note each, predictions for five years from now. Tape it shut and date it.

ideas.title: Paper-folding challenge
ideas.desc: Follow the same origami tutorial at the same time and compare results. Start with a crane; end with whatever happens.

ideas.title: Fire pit or balcony s'mores
ideas.desc: A fire pit if you have one, a candle and skewers if you do not. Sticky fingers and an excuse to sit outside in the dark.

ideas.title: Dessert-only dinner
ideas.desc: Skip the main course once. Three small desserts, shared, eaten slowly. Rank them and argue about the ranking.

ideas.title: Vision board for the year ahead
ideas.desc: Old magazines or a shared online board. Build one for the two of you: places, habits, a project, something just for fun.

ideas.title: Two truths and a dream
ideas.desc: Each of you shares two true stories and one thing you wish had happened. The other guesses which is the dream.

ideas.title: Watch party over video call
ideas.desc: Press play at the same second and keep the call open. Agree a snack in advance so you are eating the same thing.

ideas.title: Cook the same recipe on a call
ideas.desc: Choose a simple recipe, shop separately, cook together on video and eat at the same table, five hundred miles apart.

ideas.title: Open a surprise delivery together
ideas.desc: Each sends the other a small parcel timed to arrive the same week. Open them on a call, at the same moment.

ideas.title: Virtual museum tour
ideas.desc: Many major museums offer free online tours. Share a screen, wander and each choose the one piece you would take home.

ideas.title: Online game night
ideas.desc: Free browser versions exist for drawing games, word games and cards. Keep voices on; the chatter matters more than the score.

ideas.title: Parallel evening on a call
ideas.desc: Stay on video while each of you does something ordinary: cooking, reading, folding laundry. Being around each other is the point.

ideas.title: Map out your next visit
ideas.desc: Open a shared map and pin what you will do when you are next in the same place. Anticipation is half the pleasure.

ideas.title: Golden-hour walk with a flask
ideas.desc: Check when the sun sets, leave forty minutes before, bring something hot to drink and take the long way round.

ideas.title: Farmers' market challenge
ideas.desc: Give yourselves ten dollars each and split up. Meet in twenty minutes and build lunch from whatever you both bought.

ideas.title: Hike to a view
ideas.desc: Pick a trail that ends somewhere worth sitting. Pack a snack for the top and stay until one of you gets cold.

ideas.title: Picnic in a park you have never visited
ideas.desc: Choose a green space on the map that neither of you knows. Simple food, a blanket and no plan for afterwards.

ideas.title: Bookshop date
ideas.desc: Separate for fifteen minutes and each choose a book the other should read. Explain your choice over coffee.

ideas.title: Museum on a free day
ideas.desc: Most museums have a free evening or day each month. Each of you picks a favourite piece and explains it badly.

ideas.title: Mini golf
ideas.desc: Silly enough that nobody can take it seriously. Invent a forfeit for every hole lost.

ideas.title: Bowling night
ideas.desc: Rented shoes level everyone. Bowl one round normally and one with your weaker hand.

ideas.title: Thrift shop outfit challenge
ideas.desc: Set a ten-dollar limit and choose a complete outfit for each other. Wear it to dinner. No vetoes.

ideas.title: Coffee shop crawl
ideas.desc: Three cafes, one small drink in each, a walk in between. Score them on coffee, chairs and people-watching.

ideas.title: Take a class together
ideas.desc: Pottery, pasta, glass-blowing, knife skills. Being beginners side by side is a quick way to see each other fresh.

ideas.title: Live music at a small venue
ideas.desc: Pick a local act you have never heard of. Small rooms are cheap, loud in a good way and easy to leave if it is awful.

ideas.title: Comedy or open-mic night
ideas.desc: Laughing in the same room does a lot of work for you. Sit a few rows back unless you want to be part of the act.

ideas.title: Bike ride with a snack stop
ideas.desc: Pick a bakery or ice-cream place a few miles away and make it the destination. The ride home is the dessert tax.

ideas.title: Tourists in your own city
ideas.desc: Do the things visitors do and locals never get round to: the viewpoint, the walking tour, the famous sandwich.

ideas.title: Outdoor or drive-in movie
ideas.desc: Blankets, a flask and a film under the sky. Check local parks; many run free screenings through the warm months.

ideas.title: Indoor climbing session
ideas.desc: Most gyms offer a beginner session with shoes included. Cheering each other up a wall builds trust quickly.

ideas.title: Kayak, canoe or paddleboard
ideas.desc: Rent by the hour on calm water. A double kayak is a famously honest test of how well you communicate.

ideas.title: Volunteer for a morning
ideas.desc: A food bank shift, a park clean-up, a shelter walk. Doing something useful together is its own kind of closeness.

ideas.title: Dessert crawl
ideas.desc: Skip dinner and visit three places for one shared dessert each. Walk between them and keep score.

ideas.title: Botanical garden stroll
ideas.desc: Slow, pretty and built for wandering. Each of you chooses the plant that most resembles the other, and explains.

ideas.title: Food truck or night market dinner
ideas.desc: Order one thing each from different stalls and share everything. Standing up to eat makes it feel like a small festival.

ideas.title: Ice skating
ideas.desc: Holding on to each other is practically required. Finish with something hot to drink while your feet recover.

ideas.title: Pick-your-own fruit
ideas.desc: Apples in autumn, berries in summer. Pick more than you need and turn the surplus into a pie or jam that evening.

ideas.title: Pumpkin patch and carving
ideas.desc: Choose a pumpkin for each other, carve them at home and put both on the doorstep. Roast the seeds.

ideas.title: Holiday lights walk
ideas.desc: Find the most decorated streets nearby and judge every house. Hot chocolate in a flask, gloves, slow pace.

ideas.title: Beach day with a sunset finish
ideas.desc: Arrive mid-afternoon when the crowds thin, swim, eat something salty and stay until the sun is gone.

ideas.title: Drive out to see the stars
ideas.desc: Get thirty minutes away from city lights, lie on the bonnet or a blanket and stay for one full hour.

ideas.title: Arcade night
ideas.desc: Set a token budget, pool your tickets and choose one ridiculous prize together at the end.

ideas.title: Pub or cafe quiz night
ideas.desc: Join a quiz as a team of two. You will find out fast which of you knows capitals and which knows pop lyrics.

ideas.title: Dress up for a proper dinner
ideas.desc: Book the place you keep saying is for a special occasion. Order the thing you cannot make at home, and dessert.

ideas.title: Go back to where you met
ideas.desc: Return to the place it started, or the nearest version of it. Retell the story from both sides.

ideas.title: Flea market morning
ideas.desc: Five dollars each to find the strangest object for the other. Coffee first; haggling is optional.

ideas.title: Photo walk
ideas.desc: Choose a theme such as doors, dogs or one colour. Shoot on your phones for an hour and pick each other's best three.

ideas.title: Library date
ideas.desc: Each choose three books for the other from sections they would never visit. Read the first pages aloud, quietly.

ideas.title: Escape room
ideas.desc: Sixty minutes, one locked room and a clear view of how you each behave under pressure. Better with a second couple.

ideas.title: Aquarium or zoo visit
ideas.desc: Plenty to look at and talk about, with no pressure to fill silences. Decide which animal each of you would be.

ideas.title: Sledding or snowman building
ideas.desc: The first decent snowfall, a hill, something to slide on. Build a snowman of each other afterwards.

ideas.title: Fly a kite
ideas.desc: A cheap kite, a windy hill and twenty minutes of getting it wrong before it finally lifts.

ideas.title: Scavenger hunt or geocaching
ideas.desc: Use a free geocaching app or write each other a list of ten things to find in your neighbourhood.

ideas.title: Day trip to a town an hour away
ideas.desc: Choose a small town within an hour, arrive with no plan and ask the first shopkeeper where to eat.

ideas.title: Tour open houses
ideas.desc: Spend a weekend afternoon wandering homes for sale. Decide where the sofa would go and who gets the good wardrobe.

ideas.title: Garden centre plant adoption
ideas.desc: Each choose a plant for the other, name it and take joint custody. Low stakes, long-lasting souvenir.

ideas.title: Paint-your-own pottery
ideas.desc: Paint a mug for each other. You collect them a week later, which builds in a second date.

ideas.title: Roller skating
ideas.desc: Loud music, questionable balance and a good reason to hold hands. Rinks often run cheap evening sessions.

ideas.title: Tasting flight
ideas.desc: Wine, cider, tea, coffee or chocolate. Order a flight, taste slowly and write your own ridiculous tasting notes.

ideas.title: Autumn leaves drive
ideas.desc: Pick a scenic road, a playlist and a farm stand to stop at. Take turns choosing when to pull over.

ideas.title: Lake or pool afternoon
ideas.desc: Swim, float, read, repeat. Bring more snacks than seems reasonable.

ideas.title: Ferry or train ride to nowhere
ideas.desc: Take a cheap scenic route to the end of the line, have a coffee and come straight back. The ride is the date.

ideas.title: Sunrise breakfast picnic
ideas.desc: Set an alarm, bring pastries and a flask and watch the day start from somewhere with a view. Nap later.

ideas.title: Dog park visit
ideas.desc: Bring your own dog or simply go to watch. Award prizes for best ears, worst behaviour and most like you.

ideas.title: Hot chocolate walk
ideas.desc: Buy the best hot chocolate nearby and walk until the cups are empty. Short, warm and easy to extend.

ideas.title: Late-night diner run
ideas.desc: Go out after ten for pie, chips or pancakes in a booth. Ordinary food feels like an occasion at that hour.

ideas.title: Fifteen-dollar dinner challenge
ideas.desc: Fifteen dollars and fifteen minutes in the supermarket to shop for a three-course meal. Cook it together afterwards.

ideas.title: Hotel night in your own town
ideas.desc: Book one night somewhere nearby with a good breakfast. A different bed and no chores change the whole mood.

ideas.title: Community centre class
ideas.desc: Ballroom, ceramics, archery, improv. Local centres run one-off sessions cheaply, and you get to be new at it together.

ideas.title: Racket sports in the park
ideas.desc: Tennis, pickleball or badminton on a public court. Play one serious set and one where everything counts as in.

ideas.title: Planetarium or science museum
ideas.desc: Lean back under a dome of stars, then press every button in the hands-on gallery like the children do.
